mode: Native PostgreSQL ordinary WITH over checked SELECT scopes with UTF-8 and standard-conforming strings.

WithProjection.role: A complete ordinary WITH query with ordered definitions and an enclosing projection.
WithProjection.structure: A nonempty ordered definition list, the body, and the native release. Definitions and the body either own an independent query or refer to an available local definition.
WithProjection.conditions: All internal reads target a definition visible at that position and select existing output slots. All independent queries share the language profile and one ordered native input signature.
WithProjection.meaning: Introduce the definitions in order and evaluate the body in that lexical environment. Each read selects its columns from its exact source relation with the declared policy.
WithProjection.sql: Emit fresh internal relation and heading names by position, the native materialization keywords and the checked SELECT for each definition and for the result.

WithDefinition.role: An ordinary local relation definition with its checked body and explicit native materialization policy.
WithDefinition.structure: An independent SELECT or a read of an earlier local relation, or an independently scoped nested WITH query, paired with a closed policy.
WithDefinition.conditions: Check references to earlier definitions at the owning WITH boundary. An independent body supplies a nonempty ordered heading.
WithDefinition.meaning: Provide a typed relation resolving to this declaration ordinal, with the policy that controls native CTE planning.
WithDefinition.sql: Emit the body inside its named WITH definition and apply its declared policy.

WithRead.role: An ordered projection of explicitly resolved local columns.
WithRead.structure: A nonnegative definition ordinal and an owned nonempty ordered list of checked output labels and source slots.
WithRead.conditions: The enclosing WITH validates the referenced definition and every source slot against its ordered heading before publication.
WithRead.meaning: Read that exact local relation and project those slots in sequence, preserving duplicates and NULL.
WithRead.sql: Emit fully specified internal relation and slot aliases and the chosen output names.

WithMaterialization.role: A closed ordinary PostgreSQL common-table materialization policy.
WithMaterialization.conditions: The single associated definition stores one of the three policies.
WithMaterialization.meaning: Allow native choice, force the materialized boundary or allow native inlining under the admissible SELECT profile.
WithMaterialization.sql: Omit the default keyword or emit the selected native keyword before the definition.

structure: An ordinary WITH retains a lexical definition sequence including unused definitions. Each dependent projection addresses exact declaration and output coordinates. Nested independent WITH values own distinct lexical environments.
conditions: Accept unbounded nonrecursive SELECT definitions and bodies within the closed query roles, including simple exact local projections. Bind a read only to earlier definitions in its own scope. Check each native position and type across all constituent SELECTs before publication.
meaning: A definition contributes its native row bag with its ordered typed heading. A read composes positional selection over that bag. Absolute external references avoid capture by similarly named local declarations. Existing supported native parameter positions agree across independent scopes.
sql: Render explicit WITH definitions and lexical reads. Use generated internal aliases for relation and field coordinates, preserve the user-observable final heading and reproduce independent native SELECT clauses.
